# Pikabu

> > Pikabu is a Russian social platform for sharing trending memes, humor, and user-generated content organized by communities and topics.

Pikabu is one of Russia's largest social networks, featuring a homepage-driven feed of trending posts, community directories, and thematic content discovery. The platform also offers integrated services including job listings, online courses, gaming, and financial education.

## Key Topics

- trending posts
- user-generated content
- memes and humor
- communities
- content categories
- social discussion
- daily feed
- best posts
- Russian social platform
- content discovery
- Москва (Moscow)
- Россия (Russia)
- advertising
- privacy policy
- Telegram

## Core Content & Discovery

- [Горячее – самые интересные и обсуждаемые посты](https://pikabu.ru): Pikabu homepage featuring trending posts, memes, humor and user-generated content
- [Лучшие посты за сегодня](https://pikabu.ru/best): Best daily posts on Pikabu curated by user votes and engagement
- [Свежие посты](https://pikabu.ru/new): Fresh user-generated content feed with newest posts and videos
- [Темы](https://pikabu.ru/themes): Content category directory for browsing posts by topic

## Communities

- [Сообщества](https://pikabu.ru/communities): Community directory with themed groups for gaming, science, books, IT and crafts

## Integrated Services

- [Медиакит Пикабу](https://special.pikabu.ru/mediakit): Advertising mediakit with audience demographics and brand integration rates
- [Твои финансы](https://pikabu.ru/tvoi-finansy): Financial education and investment guide with T-Bank partnership
- [Агрегатор онлайн-курсов](https://education.pikabu.ru): Online course aggregator for programming, analytics, design and education
- [Работа и Вакансии](https://vacancies.pikabu.ru): Job listings and vacancy board for Moscow and regional positions
- [Бесплатные игры онлайн](https://games.pikabu.ru): Free browser-based games catalog with puzzles, shooters and casual games

## Optional

- [Согласие на обработку ПД при регистрации](https://pikabu.ru/information/consent): Personal data processing consent and privacy agreement
- [Согласие на получение рекламных и информационных сообщений](http://pikabu.ru/go/sub_email): Email subscription and advertising consent form
- [Пополнить Стим](https://games.pikabu.ru/payment/steam): Steam wallet topup guide with payment methods for Russian users
